rules.use_when: fanning out background sub-agents that each produce data you must persist
rules.content: Gate the final write/commit on confirmed delivery from EVERY sub-agent; never commit on idle-notifications or a timeout, and mark ledger items processed only after results are collected
rules.causal_note: a straggler agent delivered after commit/push, causing a messy follow-up and silent data loss

rules.use_when: creating a new numbered task or doc folder (docs/tasks/NNN-*)
rules.content: Before creating a numbered folder, verify the ID is free both locally (ls) and on origin/main (git ls-tree); hard-stop with an ID-CONFLICT marker if taken
rules.causal_note: parallel planning agents pick the same next number and collide on merge
